618-1916-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-8174.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

34-147-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-3967.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-413-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-413-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Stitch Together.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-1981-2415-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-5468.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

3532-3594-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-3594-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1061-4013-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-4013-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-2011-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2011-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1753-2011-3259.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

3750-6898-7017.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Zuko.
You have at least five experience counters.
3750-6898-7017.description:
Declare Zuko as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of experience counters you have.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Electro.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-6898-7017.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may kill Electro and use its triggered ability to deal infinite damage to target player.

1286-2921-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-2921-5972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1894-2173-2324-5220.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3101-3292-3892-4927.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-4927.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-4927.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

511-817-1887-4050-6705.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Frog and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

803-1789-5649-6797.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3284-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2438-3284-4550-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1636-5917.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
1636-5917.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of another nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1766-1978-5793.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

628-5256-5490.notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-5256-5490.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Pith Driller's power.
Repeat.

178-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

567-1981-2557-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
567-1981-2557-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating 100 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

4010-4050-4659.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{W} plus an additional {3} available for each time you've cast Farmer Cotton from the command zone this game
4010-4050-4659.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton from the command zone by paying {3}{G}{W} plus an additional {3} available for each time you've cast Farmer Cotton from the command zone this game.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and at least two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food tokens, adding {C}{C} for each Food sacrificed this way.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Halfling tokens, adding {1}{G} plus {1} for each Halfling sacrificed beyond the first two.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Farmer Cotton, adding {W}.
Choose to return Farmer Cotton to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

4222-4772-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4772-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.

1628-3197-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
1628-3197-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2493-2510-3573.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2493-2510-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
